component.name: Warmux
component.summary: Turn-based artillery battles between free-software mascots

description.p: Teams of free-software mascots (Tux, Gnu, Firefox, Wilber and friends) take turns blasting each other across destructible 2D maps with bazookas, grenades, baseball bats, ropes and plenty of other questionable equipment.

Play hot-seat on one computer, against the AI, or over the network. This is a maintained fork of Warmux 11.04, ported to SDL2: it runs natively on Wayland, renders at the size of its window and keeps held keys working for charge-up weapons and the rope.
Windows and Android ports, smoother and sharper graphics:

ul.li: Sharp text and interface at high display scales
Faster drawing of the game screen and weapons menu

description.p: First release of the maintained fork:

ul.li: Ported to SDL2: native Wayland, noticeably snappier
Renders at the window's size, with a display scale setting
Game controller support, including menu navigation
Held keys work for charge-up weapons and the rope
Many bug fixes and modern toolchain support
